servinfo.title: Piston Cooling Jet Valve Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove engine undercover.
Disconnect connector from oil piston cooling jet valve.
Remove piston cooling jet valve (1) from cylinder block.

servinfosub.title: Installation

attention4.ptxt: Reinstallation of piston cooling jet valve may cause oil leakage.
Once the valve is removed, replace it with a new one.

servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Check mesh filter in piston cooling jet valve for cleanliness.
Apply engine oil to O-ring of piston cooling jet valve.
Tighten piston cooling jet valve bolt (1) to specified torque.
